name: room-playlist
prepare: (() => { const want = ["片单和选集","片单"]; const vis = (el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden'; }; const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=tab], a')].filter(vis); const hit = all.find((el) => want.some((w) => (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').startsWith(w) || el.textContent.trim() === w)); if (hit) hit.click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(hit ? 'clicked' : 'none'), 1500)); })()

name: my-sheet
prepare: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('.tm-video-card-tile'); if (!card) return 'none'; const r = card.getBoundingClientRect(); card.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.x + 10, clientY: r.y + 10 })); return new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => res('opened'), 1800)); })()

'clicked' : 'none'), 1800)); })(); })()
